speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, I am so sorry I dragged you through this. You were right about my motives. I was hoping to establish a relationship with Penny that might have someday led to sex.

speaker: Sheldon
text: It's okay. It wasn't my first Pam thing, and it won't be my last. You got me out of my pants.

speaker: Leonard
text: Anyway, I've learned my lesson. She's out of my league. I'm done with her. I've got my work. One day I'll win the Nobel Prize, and then I'll die alone.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Don't think like that. You're not going to die alone.

speaker: Leonard
text: Thank you, Sheldon. You're a good friend.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're certainly not going to win a Nobel Prize.

speaker: Raj
text: This is one of my favorite places to kick back after a quest. They have a great house ale. Yeah, I've had him since level 10. His name is Buttons. Anyway, if you had your own game character, hang out, maybe go on a quest.

speaker: Penny
text: Wow, cool tiger. That sounds interesting. Oh, I don't think I'll be able to stop thinking about it.

speaker: Raj
text: Do you think about it?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Smooth. Oh.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, oh my god, what happened?

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, your ex-boyfriend sends his regards, and I think the rest is fairly self-explanatory.

speaker: Penny
text: I'm so sorry. I really thought if you guys went instead of me, you wouldn't be such an ass.

speaker: Leonard
text: No, that was a valid hypothesis.

speaker: Sheldon
text: That was a valid hypo. What is happening to you?

speaker: Penny
text: Really, thank you so much for going and trying. This is so terrific. Thank you. Why don't you put some clothes on? I'll get my first dinner.

speaker: Leonard
text: You're great. Thank you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're not done with her, are you? Our babies will be smart and beautiful.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Not to mention imaginary.

speaker: Leonard
text: Is Thai food okay with you, Penny?

speaker: Sheldon
text: You can't have Thai food. We had Indian for lunch. They're both curry-based cuisines. It would be gastronomically redundant. I can see we're going to have to spell out everything for this girl.

speaker: Penny
text: Any ideas, Raj?

speaker: Raj
text: Turn left on Lake Street and head up to Colorado. I know a wonderful little sushi bar that has karaoke.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, that sounds like fun.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I don't know what your odds are in the world as a whole, but as far as the population of this car goes, you're a veritable Mac Daddy.
